importPresets.title: Import presets
importPresets.intro: Orca preset files (.json) and bundles (.orca_printer, .orca_filament, .zip) from desktop Orca, Snapmaker Orca or this app. Each preset must be based on a printer, filament or process preset this app has.
importPresets.madeForOther: Made for another printer. Put it on:
importPresets.keepsProcess: Keeps its layer, wall, infill, support and other model settings; speeds, line widths and the like come from the new base.
importPresets.keepsFilament: Keeps its material settings; its filament start/end G-code comes from the new base.
importPresets.savedAs: Saved as “{{name}}” (the name “{{fileName}}” is taken or not allowed).
importPresets.gcodeWarn: Changes custom G-code ({{keys}}). It runs on your printer as written, so only import it if you trust where it came from.
importPresets.dropped_one: {{count}} setting this version of Orca doesn't have was left out.
importPresets.dropped_other: {{count}} settings this version of Orca doesn't have were left out.
importPresets.room: You can keep up to {{max}} presets; only {{n}} more fit.
